findings.evidence: With Δ = P - P', bilinearity gives `g Δ P + g P Δ = 2 g P P - (g P P' + g P' P)` and `t = g P P + g P' P' - (g P P' + g P' P)`, so `g Δ P + g P Δ = M² - M_Y² + t`; then `g (Δ-ξP) (Δ-ξP) = t - ξ(M² - M_Y² + t) + ξ²M² = t(1-ξ) + ξ(M_Y² - (1-ξ)M²)`, which is `tMin_def` after dividing by `1-ξ`. No symmetry, reflexivity or basis enters. The same basis-free route is used upstream in the repo: `GPD/Kinematics.lean:318` `minkowskiProduct_deltaOrthN_self_eq` proves `⟪w,w⟫ₘ = (1-ξ²)t + 4ξ²M²` from the on-shell data and a single light-like `n`, and `tMom_le_tZero` (line 341) follows from it.
findings.fix: State first, with no `hg`/`L`/`hp`: `theorem tMom_eq_tMin_add (K) {M MY ξ : ℝ} (hM : g K.p K.p = M^2) (hMY : MY2 g K = MY^2) (hξ : ξ ≠ 1) : tMom g K = tMin M MY ξ + g (deltaLost K - ξ • K.p) (deltaLost K - ξ • K.p) / (1 - ξ)` and likewise for the bound, the equality criterion and `tMom_nonpos`. Recover the light-cone forms by specialising `ξ := xiLC L K` and rewriting `g w w = g (L.transverseProj w) (L.transverseProj w)`, which holds because `L.plus (deltaLost K - xiLC L K • K.p) = 0` (needs `hp`) and `bilinForm_self_eq_two_mul_plus_mul_minus_add` (needs `hg`); that one bridging lemma is the only place the basis is required. `setOf_tMom_eq_Iic_tMin`/`exists_tMom_eq_of_le_tMin` legitimately keep the basis.
findings.issue: `tMom_eq_tMin_add` assumes `hg : g.IsRefl`, a full `L : LightConeBasis g`, `hp : L.plus K.p ≠ 0` and ties `ξ` to `xiLC L K`; none of this is needed for the identity. Same over-strong hypothesis set is inherited by `tMom_le_tMin` (line 101), `tMom_eq_tMin_iff` (line 112) and `tMom_nonpos` (line 126), whose extra content is only `w² ≤ 0`, `w² = 0`, `0 ≤ ξ` — all supplied as hypotheses, not obtained from the basis.

summary: The exact relation `t = tMin + w²/(1-ξ)` and the bound derived from it are stated with a `LightConeBasis`, `g.IsRefl` and `L.plus K.p ≠ 0`, but hold for an arbitrary real parameter `ξ ≠ 1` with `w = Δ - ξ•P` by bilinearity alone — as the sibling GPD module already demonstrates basis-free. Prove the parameter version first and derive the light-cone statements from it.
